page.layout: One page of text, single column, left of the scan; running head at top; page number top right; no margin notes; a catchword-like signature line "L 2 Ia" at foot.

main_text.p: iuē radiaturæ concurrunt : primo enim est radiatura recta, quia nubes Iridis constituta est directe contra Solem. 2. est radiatura reflexa, quia nubes habet guttulas instar speculorum : denique 3. est radiatura refracta, quia multi radii in aquosam nubem intrant, quia nec penetrant nec reflectuntur; vt appareat nemi-nem posse esse bonum Physicum in doctrina Philoso-phica, nisi qui degustarit hæc rudimenta Optica quæ vt utilissima sunt simul & plenissima voluptatis, ita sub Coronidem huius nostræ Ilagogæ Opticæ Deo Opt. M. gratias agimus, qui tam iucundam & gratam sui nominis famam per li-berales disciplinas sparsit.

page.notes: Scan is rotated; the page is a fragment at the left edge. Some words at line ends are uncertain (e.g. "iuē", "Ilagogæ" possibly "Isagogæ"). The signature "L 2 Ia" is read as a gathering mark and may be unclear.
